name: Conventions: seeded candidates → Accept / Edit / Reject (persists) → Create skill modal → Cancel
description: Loads the Conventions page for the seeded demo repo (3 pending demo candidates, no model call), accepts two, opens and cancels an inline edit, rejects the third and reloads to prove the rejection persists, checks the Create skill button only exists once something is accepted, then opens the Create skill modal (default name repo-conventions, editable body) and cancels — nothing is saved as a skill.

steps.label: load the Conventions page for the demo repo
a Run Scan / ReScan button is present
no Create skill button while nothing is accepted

cmd: ((p,t)=>{const a=[...document.querySelectorAll('article')].find(x=>(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'').startsWith(p));if(!a)throw new Error('no card '+p);const b=[...a.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()===t);if(!b)throw new Error('no button '+t);b.click();return 'ok'})('Throw a typed AppError','Accept')
steps.label: Accept candidate 1

cmd: ((p,t)=>{const a=[...document.querySelectorAll('article')].find(x=>(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'').startsWith(p));if(!a)throw new Error('no card '+p);const b=[...a.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()===t);if(!b)throw new Error('no button '+t);b.click();return 'ok'})('Validate every request body','Accept')
steps.label: Accept candidate 2
the Create skill button appears after accepting

cmd: ((p,t)=>{const a=[...document.querySelectorAll('article')].find(x=>(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'').startsWith(p));if(!a)throw new Error('no card '+p);const b=[...a.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()===t);if(!b)throw new Error('no button '+t);b.click();return 'ok'})('Import local modules','Edit')
steps.label: click Edit on candidate 3
the card edits inline (rule field appears, no navigation)

cmd: ((p,t)=>{const a=[...document.querySelectorAll('article')].find(x=>x.querySelector('input'));if(!a)throw new Error('no editing card');const b=[...a.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()===t);if(!b)throw new Error('no button '+t);b.click();return 'ok'})('','Cancel')
steps.label: Cancel the inline edit

cmd: ((p,t)=>{const a=[...document.querySelectorAll('article')].find(x=>(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'').startsWith(p));if(!a)throw new Error('no card '+p);const b=[...a.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()===t);if(!b)throw new Error('no button '+t);b.click();return 'ok'})('Import local modules','Reject')
steps.label: Reject candidate 3
the header now counts 2 of 2 accepted
accepted candidate 2 is still accepted after reload
the rejected candidate stays gone after reload
the editable body is preloaded from the accepted rules
the modal closes without saving anything
